meta.notice: All cases are fictional and written for teaching. They are not real people, real clinical records, or research findings. Outcomes describe the fictional case only.

conventions.dates: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD; null = date not recorded (precision 'unknown'). For interventions, end null + status ongoing = not ended; end 'unknown' = ended on an unrecorded date.
conventions.null_values: Omitted or null free-text/numeric fields mean 'not recorded in the case file'.
conventions.event_order: Events are listed in chronological order; array position becomes sequence_no.

patients.presenting_concern: Daily heavy drinking with repeated unsuccessful attempts to cut down
